correctness.rationale: For all fixed theta in [0,1], Sylvester exact rational principal minors establish tangent strict negative definiteness at the three printed matrices, preserved along affine paths. Exact polynomial equal-fitness and simplex-sum identities give the candidate all-support and boundary states. Rational Bernstein sign certificates ensure the other three support fractions and denominators have the required strict signs throughout, and derivative bounds give one root per cubic. The invasion gaps have the required sign on and beyond each root. Relative entropy has strictly negative derivative away from the feasible Nash candidate and compact supported sublevels for interior starts, yielding convergence. Integrating missing-type log fitness yields exact endpoint exponents. A verifier in the package checks the finite algebra from file bytes; uniqueness and continuity follow from analytic reasoning, not finite experiments.

value.rationale: The motivating 2026 paper compares exactly three ecologically interpreted pH payoff matrices with numerical trajectories but leaves the mathematical changes between them undetermined. The two full natural straight-line pathways exhibit different sharp support transitions, one at about 25.7% versus the other near 99.5% of the payoff shift, and a more than 170-fold separation of limiting exclusion clocks. An entire-path exact classification with global convergence, robust support switches and extinction rates materially strengthens finite-time phenotype interpretations; these are model-relevant structural facts rather than arbitrary enumerations, general-theorem rewording or mere numerical reruns.
